a1w.text:
Screen 1 · Teksilo widgets
• Title bar: TitleBar 40 · leading PopoverIconButton (hamburger → MenuBar/MenuModel) + app mark + library name (small) · center SearchField (Filled) · trailing window controls.
• Panes: Splitter, 3 panes, collapsible.
• Folders: ListView + StandardListItem (icon leading, count trailing). New folder: IconButton Compact + tooltip.
• Notes: StandardListItem with subtitle (sketch icon in the subtitle leading slot, time trailing). New note: Button Ghost, icon + label.
• Note header: Text (Literata) · SegmentedControl IconText (Canvas | Reading) · Insert: PopoverButton Filled · note ⋮: PopoverIconButton.
• Formatting: Toolbar, icon toggles with tooltips, ComboBox (paragraph style), popovers for Align and Table. Height-reveals only while a text block is edited; overflows into ⌄ when narrow.
• Canvas: SceneView · dot grid CUSTOM paint · SceneCard idle / editing (1.5 px accent + Badge “Editing”) / selected (transform frame, 8 handles) · size chip CUSTOM.
• Image: SceneCard + ImageWidget + caption + Badge “ALT”.
• StatusBar: save state · named undo hint · Blocks (navigator, P2) · zoom IconButtons, % menu, Fit.

a1k.text:
Screen 1 · keyboard and screen reader
• F6 / Shift F6: menu → Folders → Notes → note header → canvas → status bar.
• Canvas: Tab / Shift Tab moves between blocks in reading order; Enter edits (text) or draws (sketch); Esc steps back: editing → selected → nothing.
• Blocks announce as “Text block 1 of 4, Ordre du jour, editing” or “Sketch, Parcours utilisateur, described, selected”.
• Formatting toolbar: roving tabindex, toggles expose pressed state. Ctrl B / I / U, Ctrl Shift X strike, Ctrl Shift 8 bullets, Ctrl Shift 7 numbered, Ctrl Shift 9 checklist, Ctrl K link.
• Save state is a polite live region; only state changes are announced.
• Focus (ink-blue ring) and selection (vermilion frame + handles) never share a colour or a shape.

a2.text:
Screen 2 · widgets: same shell, SegmentedControl on Reading · ScrollArea with one RichTextEditor per text block, ImageWidget, sketch as read-only SceneView (CUSTOM) with its title and description as text · gutter: Badge (reading position) + drag handle (CUSTOM) · focused block: IconButton Compact ↑ / ↓ (Read earlier / later) + ⋮ · drop indicator shared with ListView reorder · wide tables: horizontal ScrollArea + label (component sheet).
Keyboard / SR: blocks stay editable (Enter), the formatting Toolbar appears exactly as on canvas. Alt ↑ / ↓ reorders, announced “Moved to position 2 of 4”. Switching view is not an edit: no undo entry, nothing moves on canvas. Ctrl 1 / Ctrl 2 switch Canvas / Reading.

a3.text:
Screen 3 · widgets: drawing Toolbar replaces the formatting Toolbar · SegmentedControl IconText (Draw / Erase / Select / Pan) · width = 3 IconButton toggles in a radio group (CUSTOM glyphs) · ColorSwatch ×5 in a radio group + PopoverIconButton → ColorEdit · Undo IconButton · Button Filled “Done drawing” · card = SceneCard editing state, other blocks faded to 45 % · title = TextInput Underline in the header · “Describe this sketch” = multi-line TextInput Outlined with label and helper · Esc hint = static tooltip-styled chip (CUSTOM).
Keyboard / SR: D / E / V tools, Space-drag pan, [ and ] width. Esc cancels the stroke in progress; Esc again, Ctrl Enter or Done drawing leaves drawing mode. Keyboard users can select strokes (V, Tab) and move them with arrows or delete them. The surface’s accessible name is the description.

a7.text:
Screen 7 · widgets: Dialog (modal, 38 % scrim) with close IconButton and Done Button Filled (default) · FormLayout, label 150 / control; stacks label above control at 200 % or in French · Language = LanguageSwitcher shown as SegmentedControl · Appearance = ThemeSwitcher as RadioTileGroup (preview, icon, title, description) · Text size = TextScaleControl (Slider 80–200 % with detents, A / A buttons, value) · Reduce motion and Default view = SegmentedControl · Backups = TextInput read-only + Button Outlined “Change…” + ComboBox · Button Outlined → ShortcutSettings.
Selected choice = raised fill + outline + check icon + bold (tiles: 2 px accent border + check badge). Keyboard / SR: each group is a radio group, arrows apply instantly and announce “Dark, selected”. Esc closes.

a8a.text:
8a · note list step: Splitter collapses into a stack Folders → Notes → Note. Back = Button Plain with chevron; Breadcrumb collapses middle items to “…”. Search becomes an IconButton that opens the SearchField in the title bar. New note is the only Filled button here.
Keyboard: Alt ← goes up a level; F6 cycles title bar → breadcrumb → list → status bar.

a8b.text: 8b · note step: the canvas opens zoomed to fit (70 %), the view setting is untouched. An info Banner offers “Read this note” (this note only) and can be dismissed for good. Cards are never clipped by layout: they live in a pannable scene. Scroll or Space-drag pans; Ctrl 0 = 100 %, Ctrl 9 = fit.

a4.text:
Screen 4 · widgets: PopoverIconButton ⋮ → MenuList (icon items, right-aligned shortcuts, separators, tiny section label “Reading order · 3 of 4”). Move to trash = text_error + trash icon + last position. Position and size = Popover with caret · FormLayout 2×2 numeric TextInputs with px suffix · Checkbox “Keep aspect ratio”; text blocks show Height as read-only text and the item reads “Position and width…”.
Keyboard / SR: Shift F10 or the Menu key opens the menu on the selected block with the first item focused; every item also lives in the app menu (Block).

a5.text:
Screen 5 · widgets: ListView + StandardListItem (folders) and StandardListItem with subtitle (notes) · inline rename = TextInput Outlined in the label slot · context menu = MenuList · drag reorder = ListView drag with indicator, ghost row with shadow_md · New folder = IconButton + rich TooltipWidget with shortcut chip.
Keyboard / SR: type-ahead in both lists; F2 rename; Del trash; Alt ↑ / ↓ reorder; Ctrl Z in a focused list reads “Undo rename folder”, “Undo move note”.

a6.text:
Screen 6 · widgets: StatusBar leading item (IconWidget + Text) · Banner error with description and two Buttons, no dismiss · Snackbar with Undo action and close IconButton.
Keyboard / SR: save state is role status (polite); Save failed is role alert (announced once). The snackbar is reachable with F6 while visible and pauses its timer while focused or hovered.
